sections.plainText: Clean cast iron in five minutes

Scrape while warm
Food lifts easily before the pan cools. Use a flat wooden spatula.

Rinse, no soap soak
Hot water and a brush. A drop of soap is fine; soaking is not.

Dry and oil
Dry on the burner, then wipe a thin film of oil inside.

Scraped warm
No soaking
Oiled after drying
